description: Delete a website from the organization (soft delete: past audits, reports, and issues are preserved, and published report links keep working). Frees a slot under the plan's website limit. Re-adding the same domain later registers a fresh website with a new website_id. Call once without confirm to see what will happen; call again with confirm: true to delete. To remove many sites at once, use delete_websites.

confirm.description: Approve the deletion. Omit on the first call to see the effect; set true to delete after the user approves.

website_id.description: Website id from list_websites, run_audit, or add_website.

name: delete_website
title: Delete a website
